Data Engineer Intern

Mockco builds data tools for logistics teams. As an intern you will build pipelines in Python and SQL, work with analysts and product teams, and ship data products that real customers use every day. You will own a project end to end, from design through launch, with mentorship from senior engineers. We care about clean code, careful testing, and clear writing. You will join design reviews, write documentation, and present your work at the end of the summer. Pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field. Experience with Python and SQL.
